entries.summary: Leader devices can now be controlled from other apps on your Wi-Fi through a Control API, switched on in Group Sync. The wiki has the full reference.
Capture mode, its List/Jump action, and the pass-through browser choice are now also available inline in Settings > Menus, not only on the dedicated Capture screen.
Opening a map link now always shows the Teleport, Walk, or Do nothing choice, even with Capture mode off. Before, that link jumped straight to Maps or the browser instead.
The compass permission prompt no longer appears on launch. It is now an optional card during first-run setup that you can skip if you do not use Tap to Walk.
